description: North Central Climate Collaborative Webinar Series is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by North Central Climate Collaborative. Access a growing archive of webinars related to climate and water for farmers, natural resource managers, and communities in the north central United States. Extension professionals in this region are working to increase the flow and usability of climate information, to increase the adoption of climate-smart practices, improving water management while maintaining profitability. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
